Full round on PR #37544 (card #36798), rendered 2026-11-26T13:09Z by an isolated sub-agent of the seat. Inputs: the card body and its five comments, the PR body, its file list and net diff (one commit, 2 files, +13 −3), and the 44 check-runs on the head. Cited code was read on `main` at `81c1ae9f75`. The PR base `1af67b26cd` is an ancestor of it, and no file cited below moved between the two.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept set: unchanged, right. The diff holds no schema, no lint rule and no runtime path. The public surface it moves is one passage of the published skill file, "Form Views", three lines for three. Each claim, against the tree:

- **"still parse and steer no create or edit form": right.** No record create or edit reads a form view: the `FormViewDefinition` docblock in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts`, and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx:276` for a create or edit that an action opens. The clause carries no condition in the new sentence, which matches the code: an action that opens the form by name changes the warning, not what New and Edit load.
- **"`os validate` warns `form-view-internal-not-loaded` unless a `type: 'form'` action's literal `target` names it": right.** In `packages/lint/src/validate-internal-form-views.ts`, `formActionTarget` (lines 94 to 98) takes the target of an action whose `type` is `form` and drops one that holds a brace, and line 206 skips a site whose served name is in that set. The rule is advisory and registered for every check command (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:1882`), so `os validate` prints it as a warning.
- **"it loads as a named form": right.** `ActionRunner.executeForm` routes the target to `/forms/NAME` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:3039`). `loadInternalForm` reads `/meta/view/NAME` with that string, and `resolveInternalForm` takes any item of kind `form` without reading a default flag (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:1759` and `:1870`). The container expansion serves `form` as `OBJECT.form` and each `formViews` entry as `OBJECT.key` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:8191` and `:8200`). `examples/app-showcase` opens `showcase_task.form` this way from three actions.
- **"These load:" in place of "Two kinds of form view load:": right.** The two definitions under it are unchanged.
- **The deleted list "(sections, tabs, steps, `subforms`, `defaults`, `modalSize`)": right to drop.** It enumerated what an internal form no longer steers, and the clause that replaces it still covers the whole form. What the skill's own evals lean on stays in the file: dialog size and column count are derived (the bullet above the passage), a named form draws no child line items (the paragraph below it), and line items come from a parent field group (Master-Detail Forms).

Size: 411 lines before and after. The file is 17767 bytes on `main` and the hunk adds 22, which is 4448 tokens by the ratchet's count against the ceiling 4448 at `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1647`. Headroom is zero, so the next edit of this file pays for its own words.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` is right: the diff publishes corrected prose in the skills catalog (`packages/skills`) and nothing else. `Clause-②: no` is right: no accept set moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: nothing changes in what an author can write, and `none` takes `patch`. Both lines stand line-initial, once each, in the PR body and in the changeset body, and the dispatch claim (comment 7192305558) carries the same two values. `Check Changeset` is success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` in the dev report (comment 7192270649) is empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviations that touch this PR, all answered. The second branch for the skills line is what the card orders ("Split it into its own PR"), and the claim names both branches. `Part of` instead of a closing keyword is right while the sibling PR is open; the seat closes the card. The two declaration lines copied from the changeset match the claim that was posted after the PR opened. The other two deviations (no review request, checklist items re-audited from source) belong to the seat's L1 and to the sibling PR.
- Acceptance notes: the deleted parenthesis and the "These load:" lead are judged in ① and ④, and both hold.
- Five gates the dev could not run locally for want of a built tree: left to the head's check-runs. All 44 are complete, 28 success and 16 skipped, none red. Of the eleven required contexts, eight are success and three are skipped by the path filter (`Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`). I did not map each of the five gates to its job.
- Out-of-scope finding 1 (the named-form page takes a field's width from `colSpan` and does not read `span`, by source read only): not this diff's, since the passage teaches no `span`. No card number for it is on the thread. Escalated to the adopting seat: file it through the filing gate, or name its carrier.
- Out-of-scope finding 2 (form view `subforms` has no form-view reader while the liveness ledger grades it live): carrier named, #36544. It agrees with what the skill keeps teaching, that a named form draws no child line items.
- SQL push-down: the diff holds no query code. Nothing to flag.
- Author: the PR's `user.login` is the fleet bot, so no off-relay author note is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, judged against the card's scenario and the code on `main`. The card carries no eval prompt of its own. Its acceptance scenario is its business reason: an author who reads the skill is told that a form their action opens is dead and reported, and may delete a working form. With the new sentence that author reads that the form is not reported and loads as a named form. The scenario holds.

Tried to break it:

- An author declares `formViews.create` and a form action on it in order to steer New. The sentence does not allow that reading: "steer no create or edit form" carries no condition, and the section still opens with "An object's New and Edit forms are not form views".
- `formViews.default` beside an unnamed `list`. The list claims `OBJECT.default`, so the form is served as `OBJECT.default_2` (`view.zod.ts:8166` and `:8191`). An action on `OBJECT.default` then names the list and not the form. The rule still warns on the form, which is correct, and `view-ref-form-target-kind` errors on the action (`packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts`). The rule compares the served name, and the sentence is true under that reading of "names it".
- An interpolated target. The rule exempts nothing for it, and "literal" says so in one word.
- The skill's own evals that involve forms (`evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: the support-case view file, the stepped invoice entry, the 42-field opportunity form). Each expected answer still follows from the file: no form view for New or Edit, an internal form parses and is not loaded, no `modalSize`.
- Other copies of the old wording under `skills/`: none. `SKILL.md` trap 1 and `skills/README.md` agree with the new sentence.

Nits. Neither changes what an author should write:

- N1 (nit) — the passage does not give the name a container's `form` is served under (`OBJECT.form`). The next paragraph gives `OBJECT.key` for `formViews` entries only, and "names it" follows a three-item subject, so an author cannot derive that name from the skill. `os explain form-view-internal-not-loaded` states it, and a wrong guess is reported by `view-ref-form-target-missing` or `view-ref-form-target-kind`. Accepted deviation: the file has no token headroom.
- N2 (nit) — "unless" names one of the rule's two exemptions. A default or create form shared publicly (`sharing.enabled: true`) is not reported either (`validate-internal-form-views.ts:204`). The old sentence named neither, and the "A public form" paragraph below it already says such a form loads. Accepted deviation.

Neither nit is to be fixed on this head: the file is a governed face, and an edit there moves the head out from under this record.

- 影响：用这个技能写应用的 AI 读到的说明改对了，不会再因为旧说法删掉一张还在用的表单。代码和平台行为都不变。
